decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted Fish & Chips 101 High St, Feltham Middx sign, proposed block and Design and Access Statement. Received: 26th March 2013  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for hot food takeaway (A5)  purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times Monday to Friday - 11.30 - 14.00 and 17.00 - 22.00, Saturday 11.30 - 14.00 and 17.00 - 22.00.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 5 - The rating level of noise emitted from fixed plant on the site, shall be lower than the existing background noise level by 10dB. The noise levels shall be determined at the nearest noise sensitive locations. The levels shall be determined according to BS4142:1997.

Condition : 6 - The premises shall only be used for A5 (hot food takeaway) purposes of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
description: Change of use of the property from existing community European office (B1 use) to proposed fish and chip shop (A5 use) incorporating a kitchen extract duct at rear of property.
